# Starter Kit City Builder

Source: https://github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-City-Builder
Commit: 4535092b740b378b700efd9df9e27a631815b84a
Store: https://store.godotengine.org/asset/kenney/starter-kit-city-builder/

Code, including `scripts/`, is MIT. Copyright (c) 2025 Kenney. The licence text is `LICENSE.md`.

3D models, sprites, and sounds are CC0, as stated on the Godot asset store page for this kit.

`fonts/lilita_one_regular.ttf` is Lilita One, SIL Open Font License 1.1. The licence text is `fonts/license.txt`. Reserved font name: Lilita.

`sample map/map.res` is the kit's sample town (122 cells, cash 5860), re-saved so its script paths point at this folder. F3 loads it. Play starts on an empty grid with $10000, same as the upstream project.
